name: technobase/laravel-system-status
description: A status page for Laravel backoffices: read-only probes, real per-route traffic, signals, automatic incidents, Telegram alerts and 1h / 24h / 7d / 90d history.

suggest.laravel-notification-channels/telegram: Sends status changes to a Telegram chat.
suggest.spatie/laravel-permission: Provides hasRole() for the page's role check.
suggest.barryvdh/laravel-dompdf: Adds PDF export to the monthly uptime report.
suggest.laravel/pulse: Shows a System Status card on the Pulse dashboard.

scripts.lint: pint --test --preset laravel src config routes lang database tests
scripts.format: pint --preset laravel src config routes lang database tests
